description: Immutable initial allowance pinned at Phase 7 slice 1 (base 464806f) for WARM_MODULE_NAMES entries with no registry operation behind them. test_module_warm_parity.WARM_WITHOUT_REGISTRY_OPERATION must be a subset of this set. Removing entries is allowed; adding here needs explicit maintainer review. Review rule: any change to an existing ceiling needs a commit trailer 'Ceiling-Review: <reason>' (CI: scripts/check_ceiling_review.py), and entries may never exceed the original content pinned in python/test_allowlist_ceilings.py plus its explicit DELIBERATE_DELTA.
